import html # Existing template with placeholders that will be replaced by actual values. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html(author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str Name of the user who posted. post_title : str Title of the forum post. content : str Main body of the post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A fully escaped HTML string ready for rendering. """ # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. safe_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Each tag is escaped and wrapped in a element. safe_tags = " ".join(f'{html.escape(tag)}' for tag in post_tags) # Substitute placeholders with the escaped values. html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=safe_author, title=safe_title, content=safe_content, tags=safe_tags ) return html_output.strip()
